core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghannam is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Shepherd, keeper of sheep”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghannam corresponds to the Arabic form غنام (Arabic root غ ن م (gh-n-m); غنّام (Ghannām)). Its core sense is shepherd, keeper of sheep. Ghannam is Arabic غنّام (Ghannām) 'shepherd, keeper of sheep', from غنم (ghanam) 'sheep, livestock'. The source gloss 'traveller, journey' belongs to a different root (س ف ر) and has been replaced.
